# `kernel/net/netinet` — the TCP/IP protocol family (IP, ICMP, TCP, UDP)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the TCP/IP protocol family (IP, ICMP, TCP, UDP).

`config.mk` records 18 source file(s) here: `if_ether.c`, `igmp.c`, `in.c`, `in_cksum.c`, `in_pcb.c`, `in_proto.c`, `ip_icmp.c`, `ip_input.c`, `ip_mroute.c`, `ip_output.c`, `raw_ip.c`, `tcp_debug.c`, ....

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文
